positioning.company: Aureon Zorza Technologies is a research-led systems and innovation company.
positioning.thesis: One proposed common systems grammar. One local-first software organism. One cross-cutting evidence control plane. Many high-consequence applications.

evidence_control_plane.name: Evidence OS
evidence_control_plane.role: Cross-cutting provenance, authority and review control plane within Aureon OS
evidence_control_plane.evidence_state: Company-built architecture with independent assurance still open

positioning.application_model: Mission-specific blades translate the shared method into bounded sector propositions and prototypes.
positioning.feedback_loop: HNC research question → Aureon OS workflow → Evidence OS source lineage → claim state → human authority → bounded action → retained receipt → new evidence.
positioning.core_owner: Evidence OS, operating as the cross-cutting control plane within Aureon OS

evidence_states.label: Implemented core
evidence_states.meaning: Company-built source, workflow or control logic is inspectable.

evidence_states.label: Tested prototype
evidence_states.meaning: A bounded prototype or protocol has local test evidence; domain outcomes remain unproven.

evidence_states.label: Sector programme
evidence_states.meaning: A defined use case and next validation route exist; no customer deployment or outcome is implied.

evidence_states.label: Open research hypothesis
evidence_states.meaning: An attributable proposition and test route exist; independent validation remains open.

positioning.boundary: HNC is Aureon's proposed common systems grammar, not established universal science. Aureon OS is the company-built local-first software organism, not proof of autonomous production operation. Evidence OS is the provenance, authority and review control plane within Aureon OS, not the whole company or independent assurance. A blade is an evidence-labelled application route, not a customer deployment, partnership, investment outcome or independent validation.

lanes.label: Available for scoped evaluation
lanes.description: Company-owned operating workflows that can be inspected and scoped now. No customer outcome or production certification is implied.

lanes.label: Scalable sector theses
lanes.description: Mission-specific applications of the same core. Commercial validation and qualified delivery partners remain external proof gates.

lanes.label: Gated deep-tech options
lanes.description: Research-led programmes that advance only through explicit physical, technical, partner and independent-authority proof gates.

blades.name: Grant and diligence evidence operations
blades.buyer: Evidence-heavy SMEs, funders, technical reviewers and delivery teams
blades.problem_or_use_case: Turn scattered evidence into a source-linked review packet with a named human approval gate.
blades.strategic_relevance: A scoped commercial entry point for evidence-heavy organisations that need faster review without sacrificing provenance or human authority.
blades.public_evidence_basis: Public source and architecture material establish the reusable evidence-control mechanism and its stated boundaries.
blades.next_validation: Run one design-partner workflow end to end and measure review time, source coverage and unresolved-gap detection.
blades.public_boundary: Inspectable source and a company-built implementation do not establish production deployment, customer adoption, revenue or independent security validation.

blades.name: Research and technical assurance
blades.buyer: R&D teams, research leads, technical reviewers and innovation programmes
blades.problem_or_use_case: Keep hypotheses, sources, null models, test criteria, corrections and reviewer decisions connected.
blades.strategic_relevance: Extends the same evidence controls into technical diligence and research assurance, where review quality depends on traceable sources and explicit stopping conditions.
blades.public_evidence_basis: ORCID and Zenodo establish attribution and public record availability; the public notebook explains methods and versioned corrections.
blades.next_validation: Select one bounded claim, agree a reproduction method with an independent reviewer and publish the result.
blades.public_boundary: Publication proves existence and attribution; it does not prove peer review, scientific validity, engineering readiness or commercial value.

blades.name: AI governance and compute-scale evaluation
blades.buyer: AI product teams, assurance leads and research-compute programmes
blades.problem_or_use_case: Preserve test provenance, model-output context, human approval and export records during trustworthy-AI evaluation.
blades.strategic_relevance: Frames how Aureon's provenance and human-authority controls could support trustworthy-AI evaluation at greater scale.
blades.public_evidence_basis: Public code and architecture establish the basis for a governed evaluation proposition.
blades.next_validation: Secure a bounded allocation, execute a reproducible evaluation and retain the complete review record.
blades.public_boundary: The public thesis is not a claim of compute access, funding, validated performance or programme endorsement.

blades.name: Secure and resilient advanced connectivity
blades.buyer: Connectivity innovators, infrastructure teams and programme consortia
blades.problem_or_use_case: Create inspectable assurance records for network evidence, operational claims and human release decisions.
blades.strategic_relevance: Frames an inspectable-assurance proposition for resilient connectivity, where operational claims must remain attributable and reviewable.
blades.public_evidence_basis: The public shared-core architecture establishes the assurance basis for a connectivity proposition.
blades.next_validation: Identify a design partner and validate one bounded connectivity workflow.
blades.public_boundary: The public thesis is not a claim of network deployment, partner appointment or performance results.

blades.name: Evidence Studio for Createch AI workflows
blades.buyer: Creative studios, cultural organisations and AI-assisted production teams
blades.problem_or_use_case: Keep source rights, model contribution, review authority and approved outputs inspectable across creative workflows.
blades.strategic_relevance: Frames a rights-aware assurance layer for creative AI workflows without separating provenance from approval.
blades.public_evidence_basis: The public shared-core architecture establishes the provenance and authority basis for a Createch proposition.
blades.next_validation: Run a rights-aware workflow with a design partner and measure provenance coverage and approval-cycle reduction.
blades.public_boundary: The public thesis is not a claim of customer deployment, rights clearance or validated outcome.

blades.name: Energy flexibility assurance
blades.buyer: Flexibility providers, energy innovators and programme delivery teams
blades.problem_or_use_case: Attach provenance, review conditions and human authority to consumer-led flexibility evidence.
blades.strategic_relevance: Frames evidence governance for flexibility decisions where data lineage, consent and accountable authority determine trust.
blades.public_evidence_basis: The public shared-core architecture establishes an evidence-governance basis for an energy-flexibility proposition.
blades.next_validation: Agree a lawful data boundary and validate one auditable flexibility decision with a sector partner.
blades.public_boundary: The public thesis is not a claim of operational deployment, customer evidence or energy-performance results.

blades.name: Human-in-the-loop SEN evidence support
blades.buyer: Education innovators, local services and accountable planning teams
blades.problem_or_use_case: Support earlier, evidence-led planning while keeping sensitive decisions with qualified humans.
blades.strategic_relevance: Frames a non-diagnostic, human-gated evidence-support proposition for consequential education planning while retaining professional authority.
blades.public_evidence_basis: The public shared-core architecture establishes the human-authority and evidence basis for an accountable SEN proposition.
blades.next_validation: Agree ethics, safeguarding, data-governance and professional-authority boundaries with an eligible partner.
blades.public_boundary: The concept is non-diagnostic. It is not a contract, clinical validation, education partnership or authority to process child data.

blades.name: Maritime evidence and assurance
blades.buyer: Maritime technology suppliers, ports, vessel operators and programme consortia
blades.problem_or_use_case: Create audit-ready evidence for compliance and project-delivery decisions in complex maritime supply chains.
blades.strategic_relevance: Frames a reusable assurance proposition for fragmented evidence and accountability across complex maritime supply chains.
blades.public_evidence_basis: The public shared-core architecture establishes an assurance basis for a maritime proposition.
blades.next_validation: Secure an eligible maritime lead and define one asset-level evidence work package.
blades.public_boundary: The public thesis is not a claim of partnership, consortium appointment or funded activity.

blades.name: Fintech, RegTech and cyber assurance
blades.buyer: Fintech clusters, regulated SMEs and accountable-AI adoption teams
blades.problem_or_use_case: Connect compliance evidence, audit readiness and AI-governance decisions without hiding human accountability.
blades.strategic_relevance: Frames how compliance evidence and accountable-AI controls could connect in regulated workflows where auditability is commercially decisive.
blades.public_evidence_basis: The public shared-core architecture establishes a governance basis for a regulated-workflow proposition.
blades.next_validation: Select one regulated workflow, agree the control standard and recruit a qualified design partner.
blades.public_boundary: A strategic proposition is not a commercial relationship, endorsement, customer outcome or funded project.

blades.name: PULSE-CAL
blades.buyer: Earth-observation instrument teams, research laboratories and technology programmes
blades.problem_or_use_case: Test a reconfigurable plasma frequency-selective front end for calibration and interference discrimination in a representative microwave Earth-observation receiver chain.
blades.strategic_relevance: Frames a differentiated Earth-observation option that could be advanced through explicit laboratory gates.
blades.public_evidence_basis: Public research records establish the attributable basis and proof boundaries for the PULSE-CAL proposition.
blades.next_validation: Complete calibrated S11/S21, switching-time, receiver-noise, repeatability, power and thermal tests against explicit controls.
blades.public_boundary: PULSE-CAL is the formal electro-optical materials and technology (EOMT) identity. It is neither flight hardware nor a mission-endorsed instrument, and no measured performance is claimed.

blades.name: EPAS mission assurance
blades.buyer: Space and defence innovation programmes, spacecraft-resilience teams and technical partners
blades.problem_or_use_case: Develop evidence-led spacecraft-resilience concepts through bounded breadboard and hardware-in-the-loop validation gates.
blades.strategic_relevance: Provides a long-horizon mission-assurance option whose value depends on disciplined physical testing and independent technical authority.
blades.public_evidence_basis: Public research records establish the attributable basis and proof boundaries for the EPAS proposition.
blades.next_validation: Secure the relevant technical authority and execute the next laboratory or hardware-in-the-loop validation package.
blades.public_boundary: Research is not a defence contract, qualification, operational shield, mission endorsement or investment outcome.
